name: OWASP Top 10
note: The ten categories are OWASP's. Which of Assay's checks sit under each one is Assay's own mapping. Categories no check can decide become questions for a reviewer.

rules.name: A new action doesn't check who is asking
rules.question: Does every new route, query or action check, on the server, who is asking and whether they may, before it does anything?

rules.name: Any website may call this API
rules.good: allow the origins you know, by name

rules.name: A file is made writable by everyone
rules.good: give the owner, and only the owner, write access

rules.name: Debug mode is switched on
rules.good: read it from the environment, off by default

rules.name: A new dependency has a name close to a popular one
A package runs a script when it is installed
rules.good: no install hook, or one you have read

rules.name: A dependency isn't a fixed registry version
A dependency was added or changed
rules.bad: a package nobody chose on purpose
rules.good: a package someone read, pinned and can name a reason for

rules.name: A weak hash is used
rules.good: createHash('sha256'), or a password hash such as argon2

rules.name: A guessable random number may be used as a secret
Certificate checking is turned off
rules.good: leave verification on; trust the one extra certificate you need

rules.name: Untrusted text inserted as HTML
Code is built and run from a string
rules.good: a lookup table, or a parser for the one format you accept

rules.name: A shell command is built from text
A database query is built from text
A new feature has no answer for being abused on purpose
rules.question: If someone abuses this feature on purpose rather than misusing it by accident, what stops them? Is there a limit, a quota or a confirmation where the damage would be large?

rules.name: A signed token may be accepted without checking the signature
Data is turned back into objects unsafely
rules.ref: A08 Software or Data Integrity Failures · CWE-502

rules.name: A new failure path leaves nothing to investigate
rules.ref: A09 Security Logging and Alerting Failures
rules.question: Does a new failure, login or permission change leave a log line someone could investigate later, without secrets or personal data in it?

rules.name: A check with an early exit was removed
rules.ref: A10 Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions · CWE-754
rules.bad: first = items[0]   (the empty-list guard is gone)
